Name: Another Island Obelisk
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4][color=#00ffff]Wish I had a cute little parrot on my farm![/color]
[color=#ffff00]Its look and text changes with time, weather, and the seasons![/color][/size]


English and Japanese are supported.


[color=#00ff00][size=5]open conditions[/size][/color]
[spoiler]
Wizard's friendship level is 7 or higher.
State of access to the farm on the Island. (The turtle is being removed.)
State of access to the island's excavation site. (The bridge in the northwestern part of the city is being repaired.)
If you meet all of the above requirements, you will receive an email. Once you open it, you will be able to build.[/spoiler]


[size=4]With "[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11887][size=5]Mini Obelisk[/size][/url][size=4]" you can change the look and feel of the parrot without changing the parrot or its functions.[/size]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/0ScP7Ww.png[/img]
